ruleDefinitions.name: Cloudflared Tunnel Connections Cleanup
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the "cloudflared" tool with the tunnel "cleanup" flag in order to cleanup tunnel connections.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ tunnel\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*cleanup\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-config\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-connector\\-id\\ .*")))
